epics.goal: Remove the rebase-and-rereview chain from the coordination protocol while preserving exact-commit review guarantees, and support batch landing. (1) ready accepts a base that is an ancestor of current main (still base != head, pushed exact head). (2) land accepts one or more epics in a single call: every listed epic must be submitted with two independent approvals of its exact base and head; the changed-file sets (base..head, excluding the generated roots Complexity.lean and ComplexityTests.lean) must be pairwise disjoint and disjoint from the files main changed since each base; the tool merges the reviewed heads onto main in the coordinator worktree (no-ff merge commits naming the epic and its reviewed base and head), refuses on any textual conflict or overlap with a clear message, regenerates roots with lake exe mk_all once, runs the six project checks and the coordination tests once on the final tree, and publishes main plus every completed board record atomically; on any refusal nothing is published. The single-epic call is the batch of size one and behaves as today when base == main. Each completed record stores the reviewed snapshot and the landed main OID; the integration reservation records the main OID it was taken against and a later main move is detected. (3) Keep every existing refusal: withdrawn review, lost lease, dirty worktree, failed check, servers without atomic push. (4) Tests: protocol tests for the ancestor rule at ready, the single-epic disjointness decision and the pairwise rule; runtime tests with a temporary local remote for landing after main moved on disjoint files, landing two disjoint epics in one call, refusal on an overlapping file, refusal when two listed epics overlap, refusal on a textual conflict, and unchanged behaviour when base == main. (5) Docs: CONTRIBUTING.md land and ready paragraphs and worker instructions (no merge of main needed before ready unless files overlap); AGENTS.md proof-hygiene bullet so named #print axioms guards for headline theorems live in the epic own test module while ComplexityTests/Axioms.lean keeps the global audit and existing guards, and one sentence that ROADMAP, UPSTREAM and bibliography updates are batched by the coordinator in docs-only epics. Validate with lake -d scripts/coordination test --wfail, the strict tooling build and scripts/check.sh; self-review, frozen submission, two independent reviews. Author credit Samuel Schlesinger; AI assistance disclosed.

Singleton: [Nonempty a] d <= minDist C -> #C <= card a ^ (n - d + 1) (C : Finset (i -> a)); linear: C != bot -> finrank F C + d <= n + 1.
